To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) the U ( N ) Chern–Simons gauge theory on the Moyal plane is renormalizable; (ii) the 1PI functional is not renormalized in perturbation theory in an arbitrary axial gauge, and

the renormalized noncommutative U ( N ) Chern–Simons gauge theory can be defined perturbatively in an arbitrary homogeneous gauge; the free propagators are defined by using the Lebbrandt–Mandlstam prescription; the Green functions of the fields of noncommutative gauge theory can be calculated in perturbation theory without any loop corrections.
the noncommutative U ( N ) Chern–Simons gauge theory is renormalizable in the axial gauge and that it has the same renormalized 1PI functional as the commutative Chern– Simons gauge theory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of a renormalized noncommutative gauge theory in the axial gauge, which is free of radiative corrections.
the study of noncommutative gauge theories in the framework of the noncommutative differential geometry developed by Alain Connes.
the computation of radiative corrections of the noncommutative U ( N ) Chern–Simons gauge theory in the axial gauge.

we have shown how to compute the noncommutative U ( N ) Chern–Simons radiative corrections on a back of an envelope.
